techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/simulator/feedback/FeedbackBalanceSimulator.tsx:69 A time-derived seed instead of one derived from scenario identity, so results are not reproducible by default.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/simulator/predictive/ResultsPanel.tsx:77 EHP is shown without the hit it was computed against; the CanonChecksPanel does correctly render not-evaluated checks as 'Could not run' (line 49).

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/simulator/feedback/types.ts:32 Scenario presets exist but carry no iteration count and no cast version; iterations are typed in at the keyboard (default 500).
